summary.text: Use your MediSave to pay premiums for family members, or top up a MediSave account.

details.heading: Another way to pay
details.body: You or your family member may top up to your or their MediSave using the Top up MediSave Account online form.

steps.name: Apply to pay
steps.text: Use your MediSave to pay premiums for your spouse, parents, children, siblings or grandparents. Visit the Change Premium Payer e-Service, log in using Singpass and complete the application.

items: You can use your MediSave to pay premiums for your spouse, parents, children, siblings or grandparents.
Visit the Change Premium Payer e-Service, log in using Singpass and complete the application.

example_phrasings: Can I help my family members pay for their CareShield Life premiums?
Can I pay my parents’ CareShield Life premiums?
Can I use my MediSave to pay a family member’s premiums?

sources.page_title: Can I help my family members pay for their CareShield Life premiums?

quotes.text: You can pay the CareShield Life premiums for your family members (i.e. spouse, parents, children, siblings or grandparents) using your MediSave.
To do so, you can visit the Change Premium Payer e-Service and log in using Singpass to complete the application.
Alternatively, you/your family member may top up to your or his/her MediSave via the Top up MediSave Account online form.
